recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7156 unless OO makes a new decision requiring donor-specific Observation.focus prose.
issue_request: FHIR-7156 was a Published/Persuasive OO clarification from the DSTU1 2015 May ballot asking to insert "donor" after "fetus" in the Observation.subject comments example list.
initial_application: Commit ff6b620add130e1ad7bb20f468b7725f3b7600ce applied #7156 by adding donor to source/observation/observation-spreadsheet.xml and adding 7156 to the Observation.subject committee notes. The current StructureDefinition source still carries the 7156 committee note on Observation.subject.
additional_context: Later final OO work moved these indirect-subject semantics into Observation.focus: FHIR-14443 promoted focal-subject to Observation.focus Reference(Any), and FHIR-43357 approved the current simplified R6 wording that focus is something or someone associated with the subject plus selected examples. That later wording no longer lists donor explicitly but does not narrow donor-focused observations.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding donor to the current Observation.focus examples would be redundant with the current broad rule and would partially restore an old example list superseded by later approved wording.
